code_name: Failed rise, active stay, done ledger
summary: A white file-upload card sorts seven files into groups as they go: the too-large one is red at the top, two uploads run with a third peeking behind them, finished ones drop into a green-ticked ledger, and the slow one fails at 62% and rises to the top with Retry.
